international.title: Woman whose baby died after free birth didn’t know she was pregnant with twins, NSW inquest hears
international.summary: Inquest continues into deaths of four babies born in free births or home births in northern rivers Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A northern rivers mother whose baby died after a free birth did not know she was having twins until she was in labour after having no pregnancy scans, the New South Wales coroner’s court has heard. The inquest will examine the deaths of four babies born in free births or home births who died in the northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024. It will consider whether the care was reasonable in the circumstances and whether care by an unregistered support worker was reasonable and appropriate before, during and after the birth. Free births are when a person gives birth without a registered health professional present. Continue reading...
